taxonomic_note: Accepted by Kew/POWO; Scirpus validus is a commonly encountered historical synonym.
look_here_first: Tall colonial bulrush with soft, mostly round/terete culms and a lateral-looking cluster of drooping spikelets below a short continuation bract.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays — source-labeled San Marcos River Joey frame. Travis — City of Austin wetland guide treats S. tabernaemontani as Texas-native and locally appropriate. A third exact target-zone native county still needs authoritative documentation.
project_inclusion.learner_role: retain local diagnostic record; do not count as native PASS yet

best_field_traits: culms tall, soft, usually round to weakly triangular
leaves reduced mainly to basal sheaths
inflorescence appears lateral because a short involucral bract continues above it
many drooping spikelets on branched rays
softer/rounder culm helps separate from more strongly triangular Schoenoplectus californicus
morphology_keys.joey_field_note: Joey's close-up is useful for spikelet and inflorescence architecture; pair it with culm cross-section for separation from California bulrush.
